description: Inspect balances and availability before an allocated-capital move. Funding draws from the account's already allocated trading pool; returns go to its Arc Home. Includes Derive and treasury previews, but those moves require owner approval and are not available via API key. This is a read-only availability plan, not a provider cost quote: unknown fees and credit remain unknown. Review the returned transfer availability before separately confirming a supported start_capital_move.

amount_usd.description: Exact requested amount, with at most six decimal places.

direction.description: fund uses allocated capital; bring_home returns to Arc Home.

venue.description: Venue. treasury is allowed only for bring_home.

name: preview_capital_move
